chunks: And by this chain, from Ibrahim ibn Idris, he said:
I saw him after the passing away of Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him) when he had grown up; I kissed his hands and his head.
ai.seo_question: Who saw the Imam of the Time after the death of Abu Muhammad al-Askari and what did they do?
ai.summary: Ibrahim ibn Idris narrates witnessing the Imam (a.s) after the death of Abu Muhammad al-Askari (a.s), specifically noting the Imam had reached maturity (aifa'), a period marking the transition from minor to major occultation. He kissed the Imam's hands and head, demonstrating the customary reverence (ta'zim) accorded to the Imam even during the hidden period, a key concept in Twelver Shia eschatology.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 232 - It is narrated from the same chains from Ibrahim bin Idris that he said: “
I saw him after the passing away of Abu Muhammad Askari (a.s) when he had grown up; I kissed his hand and his head.”
